title: BUG: Double down arrows are back
body:
Hi @MilosKozak 

Sorry to reopen this subject that was fixed 😕 but it happened again with the last dev-l +PR2700

I don't know if it is important but ATM, I have 2 G6/Anubis BG sensors running with xDrip and xDrip variant1. For xDrip variant1, all propagation and updates to NS are turned off.

![Screenshot_20240413_085603_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/92720bf0-6d68-476a-bb15-8a8f29f3b4a0)

It seem to happen mostly after a compression low or faulty reading. xDrip+ in native mode (G6) then show no trend arrow. When this happens AAPS always show double down arrow. @MilosKozak what does AAPS do if xDrip+ doesn't provide trend arrrow? When smoothing BG data within AAPS, shouldn't AAPS calculate trend arrow also internally?
